author: bardic-inspiration
name: Trial by Proof
summary: A clay golem and its armored attendants put the party through the Test Chambers' trials.

parts.text: A row of small stone rooms opens off a single corridor, each with a brass plaque over its door. At the far end, a hulking figure of clay stands with four suits of armor, and a voice from nowhere announces that the trial will begin.

The Test Chambers prove that entries are what they claim to be. The {ref:creature/clay-golem} runs the trial and the {ref:creature/animated-armor} stand as its examples. Each correction the party has made earns a passing plaque here, and the golem stands down once every anomaly in the ledger has passed; until then, it fights.

parts.trigger: The party steps into the corridor and the voice announces the trial.

stages.name: The Examples
stages.loop: The animated armor step forward one at a time and fight; the golem watches.
stages.transition: Two suits of armor fall, or a hero attacks the golem.

stages.name: The Examiner
stages.loop: The golem joins the fight, slamming whoever is nearest a plaque the party hasn't earned.
stages.transition: The golem drops to half its {ref:glossary/hit-points}.

stages.name: The Last Test
stages.loop: The golem hastes itself and fights to destruction, unless the party shows it a corrected anomaly.

parts.victory: The golem is destroyed, or every plaque over the chamber doors reads passing.
